# Rollout check-context probe

This is a temporary, do-not-merge rollout probe linked to Intake #2.

It intentionally does not provide an Engineering Issue contract marker or a
contract hash. PR policy is expected to fail closed so the repository can
observe the exact GitHub check contexts before configuring the ruleset.

Baseline: `b2492eed7fc12f665364d938d32a058aeecb9f61`
